[Story]
In a restaurant, the waitress Xiao Li is providing the menu to the customers. She tells the customer Xiao Chen, "Our menu has 50 dishes, most of them are Sichuan cuisine, there are also some Cantonese dishes, but there are almost no Shandong dishes." Xiao Chen browses and finds only 10 Cantonese dishes.

[Question]
After browsing, how many Sichuan dishes does Xiao Chen guess there are?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After browsing, Xiao Chen guesses there are 50 Sichuan dishes.
B. After browsing, Xiao Chen guesses there are 45 Sichuan dishes.
C. After browsing, Xiao Chen guesses there are 35 Sichuan dishes.
D. After browsing, Xiao Chen guesses there are 40 Sichuan dishes.
